inlines.v: FLU'ENCY, noun [Latin fluens, from flue, to flow.] 1. The quality of flowing, applied to speech or language; smoothness; freedom from harshness; as fluency of numbers. 2. Readiness of utterance; facility of words; volubility; as fluency of speech; a speaker of remarkable fluency 3. Affluence; abundance. obsolete
